title: DSCformer: A Dual-Branch Network Integrating Enhanced Dynamic Snake Convolution and SegFormer for Crack Segmentation
mechanism: Dynamic snake convolution with pyramid-kernel offset prediction and bidirectional offset iteration, in a dual branch with SegFormer, plus weighted channel attention.
adaptation: Replace the last two U-Net++ decoder conv blocks with enhanced DSConv for crack-following receptive fields; encoder and other heads unchanged.
min_experiment: Arm: PF with DSConv decoder blocks; baseline: PF; 3 seeds. Metric: CV crack IoU and components found. Kill if IoU gain < +0.01.
evidence: R: IoU 59.22% on Crack3238 and 87.24% on FIND.
prior_overlap: none (snake / deformable convolutions are on the never-tried list).

alt_notes.adaptation: Replace the last two U-Net++ decoder conv blocks with DSConv on the crack path; keep the ResNet-34 encoder and 24-class head.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: PF with DSConv decoder blocks; baseline PF; 3 seeds. Metric: CV crack IoU and components >= 20 px found. Kill if IoU gain < +0.01 and components n.d.
